title: About
html:
Korea Decoded explains the Korean words you keep running into in the news, in K-dramas and in daily life, with where each word comes from and why it matters today.

Every article is researched from original Korean and English sources and lists at least two of them at the bottom, so you can check for yourself. We do not give investment, legal or immigration advice; for decisions, please consult the official agency or a licensed professional.

New posts go up on weekday mornings (US Eastern time).
